## Confirmed answer

Pedro answered Q2 "Yes, amber (Recommended)" and Q3 "Yes, trim (Recommended)".

Use AMBER as the internal example input and amber as its lowercase output. This colour choice names an example label; it introduces no visual styling.

A1 adds format-label.js with the named ES module export formatLabel(value) = String(value).toLowerCase(), with test/format-label.test.js asserting that AMBER becomes amber.

A2 extends the same helper to String(value).trim().toLowerCase(), with test/format-label.test.js asserting that padded AMBER becomes amber and preserving A1's assertion. A2 waits for A1.

B1 independently adds label-length.js with the named ES module export labelLength(value) = String(value).length, with test/label-length.test.js asserting that amber has length 5.

The final Outcome check uses fetched merged A/B SHAs to prove formatLabel(' AMBER ') === 'amber' and labelLength(formatLabel(' AMBER ')) === 5. There are no manual release steps or visible UI Verify.
